answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 33466 Country: Bangladesh Title: My brother's full name is AHMAD AL MUHAIMIN (nick name MUHAIMIN). Question: My brother's full name is AHMAD AL MUHAIMIN (nick name MUHAIMIN). MUHAIMIN is one of 99 names of Allah. Is there any problem if he is called only MUHAIMIN? Answer ID: 33466 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1248/1248/M=1432) One should not call you only Muhaimin rather one should call you Abdul Muhaimin or with your real name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
